about.title: About Me
about.text1: I am a Computer Science Engineering (AIML) student at Chandigarh University with a deep passion for building high-performance full-stack web applications and integrating advanced artificial intelligence models. I turn complex ideas into intuitive, scalable digital products.
about.text2: From architecting full-stack architectures with Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB to fine-tuning machine learning models and deploying real-time AI agents, I focus on engineering excellence, seamless user experience, and measurable real-world impact.
currently: 🎓 Pursuing B.E. CSE (AIML) at Chandigarh University

💡 Exploring Large Language Models & Agentic Workflows

projects.title: Suroor — Music Streaming Platform
projects.description: A full-stack modern music streaming web application inspired by Spotify. Features dynamic user authentication, responsive playlist management, audio streaming player, and seamless UI/UX with smooth transitions.
highlights: Custom audio playback controller with real-time waveform visualization
High performance media streaming with optimized asset delivery

projects.title: Virtual Healthcare & Appointment System
projects.description: A web-based digital healthcare ecosystem enabling patients to seamlessly schedule doctor appointments, consult virtually, and securely manage digital electronic health records.
highlights: End-to-end appointment scheduling system with automated slot management
Secure medical record storage and quick patient history lookup

projects.title: Swasthya — Smart Healthcare & Wellness
projects.description: An intelligent healthcare wellness portal combining telemedicine appointments, health tracking metrics, and automated basic health insights with an accessible, user-friendly interface.
highlights: Intuitive patient portal with symptom questionnaire and triage
Clean, responsive dashboard for healthcare professionals

resume.summary: Full-stack developer and AI/ML engineer pursuing B.E. Computer Science (AIML) at Chandigarh University. Experienced in React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, TensorFlow, and LLM integrations.

aiKnowledge.content: Dev Saini is a passionate Computer Science student specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AIML) at Chandigarh University (2024-2028). He creates full-stack applications with Next.js, React, Node.js, and integrates state-of-the-art AI models.

Dev has built major projects including Suroor (a Spotify clone with music streaming and playlist capabilities), Virtual Healthcare (appointment and patient records management system), and Swasthya (smart wellness and telemedicine platform).

Full stack development with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS; Machine Learning & Deep Learning with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Groq SDK, LLMs, and RAG architectures.
